name: ppt-master
description: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He

paragraphs: 🆕 As a finance professional (CPA · CPV · Consulting Engineer (Investment)), I drew on my expertise and project experience to build a tool website: Construction Project Economic Evaluation (in Chinese) — enter your project data and get a full financial evaluation online: investment, revenue, cost, debt service, profit, cash flow and balance sheet statements, plus IRR, NPV, sensitivity and break-even analysis, exportable to Excel / Word. Built for energy projects such as wind, solar and storage, with a general-purpose mode for other projects. The site is in an early trial phase; the first 100…
